domains.name: Fundamentals of Cybersecurity & Threat Mitigation
domains.description: Fundamentals of cybersecurity and threat mitigation: identifying threats/vulns, IR/risk basics, control evaluation, security tooling, and firewall/IDS configuration.

domains.name: Network Security & Access Control
domains.description: Network security and access control: secure network config/VPN/segmentation, traffic monitoring, access-control audits, MFA, and encryption.

domains.name: Incident Response & Threat Analysis
domains.description: Incident response and threat analysis: incident triage/documentation, digital forensics, malware analysis, supervised pen-testing, and remediation.

domains.name: Security Compliance & Risk Management
domains.description: Security compliance and risk management: regulatory frameworks, risk assessment, policy development, reporting, and compliance collaboration.

domains.name: Endpoint Security & Malware Defense
domains.description: Endpoint security and malware defense: endpoint protection/EDR, phishing/ransomware defense, patch management, email security, and awareness training.

domains.name: Cloud & Application Security
domains.description: Cloud and application security: cloud workload protection, cloud log monitoring, application security assessment, and DevSecOps.

competencies.statement: The learner can identify security threats and vulnerabilities in networks and information systems.
competencies.description: Spots common threats/vulns in a described environment.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to incident response plans and risk-mitigation strategies to protect sensitive data.
competencies.description: Helps draft/apply an IR or mitigation step.

competencies.statement: The learner can evaluate security controls for effectiveness, compliance, and weaknesses.
competencies.description: Assesses whether a control adequately addresses a risk.

competencies.statement: The learner can use security tools and frameworks to monitor, detect, and respond to cyber threats.
competencies.description: Applies the right tool/framework to a monitoring/response task.

competencies.statement: The learner can assist in configuring firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and security policies.
competencies.description: Helps configure a firewall/IDS-IPS rule or policy correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement and maintain secure network configurations, including VPNs and segmentation.
competencies.description: Applies segmentation/VPN correctly for a requirement.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor network traffic for suspicious activity and potential breaches.
competencies.description: Identifies anomalous traffic indicative of a breach.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct access-control audits for proper authentication and role-based permissions.
competencies.description: Finds an access/permission misconfiguration.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) and other access-security mechanisms.
competencies.description: Chooses/deploys appropriate access controls.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply encryption techniques to safeguard communications and data storage.
competencies.description: Selects correct encryption in transit/at rest.

competencies.statement: The learner can help identify, document, and mitigate security incidents and breaches.
competencies.description: Triages and documents an incident correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can support forensic investigations by collecting, preserving, and analyzing digital evidence.
competencies.description: Preserves evidence following chain-of-custody basics.

competencies.statement: The learner can perform malware analysis to detect, isolate, and mitigate cyber threats.
competencies.description: Identifies and contains a malware sample/behavior.

competencies.statement: The learner can assist in penetration testing and vulnerability assessments under supervision.
competencies.description: Supports a scoped test and interprets findings.

competencies.statement: The learner can work with security teams to remediate incidents and restore system integrity.
competencies.description: Executes a remediation/recovery step correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can support compliance with cybersecurity regulations and frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, HIPAA).
competencies.description: Maps a requirement to the right framework control.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct risk assessments to identify and evaluate security risks in IT environments.
competencies.description: Rates likelihood/impact and prioritizes a risk.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and best practices.
competencies.description: Drafts a usable, correct security policy.

competencies.statement: The learner can prepare reports on security posture and risk-management efforts.
competencies.description: Summarizes posture/risk clearly for stakeholders.

competencies.statement: The learner can collaborate with compliance teams to meet industry security standards.
competencies.description: Coordinates to close a compliance gap.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement endpoint protection such as antivirus and endpoint detection & response (EDR).
competencies.description: Deploys/tunes endpoint protection appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze and mitigate phishing, ransomware, and social-engineering attacks.
competencies.description: Recognizes and responds to a social-engineering/malware attack.

competencies.statement: The learner can support OS and software patch management to prevent vulnerabilities.
competencies.description: Prioritizes/handles patching to close a vuln.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure and maintain email security to block spam, malware, and phishing.
competencies.description: Sets up email security controls (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, filtering).

competencies.statement: The learner can educate employees on security awareness and best practices.
competencies.description: Delivers effective, accurate awareness guidance.

competencies.statement: The learner can assist in securing cloud applications and infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
competencies.description: Applies a cloud security control correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor cloud security logs for unauthorized access and threats.
competencies.description: Detects a threat signal in cloud logs.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct security assessments of applications to identify vulnerabilities.
competencies.description: Finds a common app vulnerability (e.g., OWASP).

competencies.statement: The learner can support DevSecOps by integrating security into the software development lifecycle.
competencies.description: Inserts a security check into a pipeline/SDLC stage.
